note: Inji Verify 1.0.0-alpha.1 baseline (the target version), from the full plan run of 2 October. All 11 modules the plan contains for this variant: 4 PASSED; 7 REVIEW, each resolved by the harness against Verify's own verdict and consistent with what the test required. Two of the 11 (request-uri-*) are not applicable to the url_query variant and are marked exercised:false. invalid-session-transcript is mdoc-only and not in this plan. Inji Certify (added 26 October): all 15 modules the OID4VCI 1.0 Final issuer plan has for the pre-authorized / SD-JWT / DPoP / private_key_jwt variant, through the gateway metadata shim for F-12. 3 PASSED, each checked against Certify's log to be rejected for the right reason; 3 SKIPPED; 1 WARNING; 8 FAILED, each traced to F-13, F-14 or F-15, or to an optional feature Certify does not offer. Moved to the 27 Oct 2026 suite build (pinned in docker/docker-compose.yml): the verifier plan dropped request-uri-fetched-twice and request-uri-method-post and added present-revoked-credential, present-credential-without-status and wrong-vct; the issuer plan dropped fail-unsupported-encryption-algorithm. Every module common to both suites gave the same result. The earlier baseline is in git history.

oid4vp-1final-verifier-happy-flow.reason: All checks pass. REVIEW resolved by the harness: Verify's own verdict accepted the valid presentation (allChecksSuccessful=true). The 27 Oct suite also warns that Verify did not fetch the credential's status list (EnsureVerifierFetchedRevocationList, SD-JWT VC s3.4 / Token Status List s8.3): Verify does not check revocation for SD-JWT credentials (F-16).

oid4vp-1final-verifier-minimal-cnf-jwk.reason: Credential with a minimal cnf JWK. REVIEW resolved: Verify accepted it, as required. The 27 Oct suite also warns that Verify did not fetch the credential's status list (EnsureVerifierFetchedRevocationList, SD-JWT VC s3.4 / Token Status List s8.3): Verify does not check revocation for SD-JWT credentials (F-16).

oid4vp-1final-verifier-invalid-kb-jwt-si.reason: Forged key-binding JWT signature. Verify answers direct_post 200 then verifies; REVIEW resolved: Verify's verdict rejected it (allChecksSuccessful=false), as required.

oid4vp-1final-verifier-invalid-credentia.reason: Forged issuer signature on the credential. REVIEW resolved: Verify's verdict rejected it, as required.

oid4vp-1final-verifier-invalid-sd-hash.reason: Tampered sd_hash. REVIEW resolved: Verify's verdict rejected it, as required.

oid4vp-1final-verifier-invalid-kb-jwt-no.reason: Wrong KB-JWT nonce. Verify rejects synchronously at direct_post (HTTP 400, 'Nonce validation failed'); the suite sees it and passes.

oid4vp-1final-verifier-invalid-kb-jwt-au.reason: Wrong KB-JWT aud. Rejected synchronously (HTTP 400, 'Client id validation failed'); suite passes.

oid4vp-1final-verifier-kb-jwt-iat-in-pas.reason: KB-JWT iat too old. Rejected synchronously (HTTP 400); suite passes.

oid4vp-1final-verifier-kb-jwt-iat-in-fut.reason: KB-JWT iat in the future. Rejected synchronously (HTTP 400); suite passes.

oid4vp-1final-verifier-present-revoked-c.reason: F-16: presented a credential whose status list marks it revoked; Verify never fetches the status list and its own verdict accepts the credential (allChecksSuccessful=true). MOSIP's vc-verifier implements status checks only for LDP credentials; for SD-JWT the check is unsupported.

oid4vp-1final-verifier-present-credentia.reason: Credential with no status claim. REVIEW resolved: Verify accepted it, as required.

oid4vp-1final-verifier-wrong-vct.reason: Credential of a type (vct) other than the one requested. Verify rejects it synchronously at direct_post (HTTP 400); the suite sees the rejection and passes.

oid4vci-1_0-issuer-metadata-test.reason: Finishes with warnings only: unknown properties in issuer and AS metadata (e.g. interactive_authorization_endpoint), and the ldp_vc FarmerCredential, a format the plan does not test.

oid4vci-1_0-issuer-metadata-test-signed.reason: Certify does not serve signed issuer metadata (an optional OID4VCI feature): no application/jwt response.

oid4vci-1_0-issuer-happy-flow.reason: F-13: Certify rejects the credential request because the test adds an unknown parameter, which OID4VCI 1.0 s8.2 says MUST be ignored. Reached through the gateway metadata shim (F-12).

oid4vci-1_0-issuer-happy-flow-additional.reason: F-15: valid proofs rejected - Certify issues the pre-authorized token with an empty client_id although the client authenticated, then requires proof iss to equal it. Through the shim (F-12).

oid4vci-1_0-issuer-happy-flow-multiple-c.reason: F-15, as happy-flow-additional-requests. Through the shim (F-12).

oid4vci-1_0-issuer-happy-flow-skip-notif.reason: F-15, as happy-flow-additional-requests. Through the shim (F-12).

oid4vci-1_0-issuer-batch-issuance.reason: Skipped by the suite: Certify does not advertise batch issuance.

oid4vci-1_0-issuer-fail-invalid-nonce.reason: Certify rejects the invalid nonce - for the right reason, per its log ('c_nonce is invalid or expired', checked before the proof).

oid4vci-1_0-issuer-fail-invalid-jwt-proo.reason: Certify rejects the bad proof signature - for the right reason, per its log ('JWT proof verification failed', not the F-15 iss check).

oid4vci-1_0-issuer-fail-invalid-key-atte.reason: Skipped by the suite: Certify does not use key attestations.

oid4vci-1_0-issuer-fail-missing-proof.reason: Certify rejects the request without a proof (request validation error) - for the right reason.

oid4vci-1_0-issuer-fail-unknown-credenti.reason: F-14: Certify answers with error invalid_credential_request; OID4VCI 1.0 defines unknown_credential_configuration.
F-13: credential_identifier is rejected as an unrecognised field, so the defined error unknown_credential_identifier is never returned.

oid4vci-1_0-issuer-fail-on-access-token-.reason: F-15: fails at the credential request that precedes the check this module targets. Through the shim (F-12).
